name: WOLP
author: Rafael Mello
description: Wake and shut down one or more PCs from an Omarchy bar panel, via Wake-on-LAN, UpSnap, SSH, Windows RPC, HTTP or a custom command.

barWidget.description: Wake-on-LAN panel for one or more PCs, with live status, ping time and shutdown.

schema.label: Name
schema.description: Shown in the panel and notifications. These settings are your first PC; add more from the panel's + button.

schema.label: Wake method
schema.description: Send the packet directly, or ask an UpSnap server to wake the device.

schema.label: MAC address
schema.description: Magic packet mode: target NIC, e.g. AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.

schema.label: Host / IP
schema.description: Magic packet mode: pinged to determine online status.

schema.label: UpSnap device ID
schema.description: UpSnap mode: the device record ID.

schema.label: UpSnap username/email
schema.description: UpSnap mode: leave empty if the device is public.

schema.label: UpSnap password file
schema.description: UpSnap mode: file containing only the password (chmod 600).

schema.label: Shutdown method
schema.description: How to shut the PC down when you click it while it is online. Independent of the wake method.

schema.label: Shutdown host
schema.description: SSH / Windows: PC address. Leave empty to use Host / IP.

schema.label: Shutdown username
schema.description: SSH: login user. Windows: account name, optionally DOMAIN\user.

schema.label: Shutdown password file
schema.description: Windows: file containing only the account password (chmod 600).

schema.label: Shutdown command
schema.description: SSH: run on the PC (default: sudo systemctl poweroff). Command: run locally with sh; $WAKE_PC_HOST and $WAKE_PC_MAC are set.

schema.label: SSH key
schema.description: SSH: private key to use. Leave empty for your default keys / agent.

schema.label: Shutdown URL
schema.description: HTTP: URL to request, e.g. a Home Assistant webhook.
